name: BEE Standards & Labeling Star-Rated Equipment Program
authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), Ministry of Power
eligible_entity: Commercial building owners, facility managers, and industrial units
technology: HVAC, Chiller Systems, VRF, LED Lighting, Distribution Transformers
eligibility: Facility procuring or retrofitting with BEE 4-Star or 5-Star certified equipment complying with Energy Conservation Building Code (ECBC) standards.
incentive_type: Standardized Rebate / Capital Subsidy via DISCOM DSM Programs
incentive_value: 10% to 20% equipment capital cost support or ₹1,000–₹2,500 per kW reduced under state DSM utility partnerships.
source: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) Official S&L Guidelines & ECBC 2017 Framework

name: SIDBI 4E (End-to-End Energy Efficiency) Scheme for MSMEs
authority: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
eligible_entity: MSME registered commercial enterprises and small manufacturing units
applicable_sector: Small Industrial, Light Manufacturing, Commercial Services
technology: Electric Motors (IE3/IE4), Industrial Pumps, Air Compressors, Variable Frequency Drives (VFD)
eligibility: Operational MSMEs undergoing certified technical energy audits and implementing equipment retrofits that achieve >= 10% verifiable energy reduction.
incentive_type: Concessional Interest Rate Financing & Technical Audit Grant
incentive_value: Concessional debt at 150 to 200 bps below normal lending rate, plus up to ₹30,000 technical audit subsidy.
source: SIDBI Energy Efficiency Financing Portfolio & Partial Risk Sharing Facility (PRSF)

name: EESL Super-Efficient Chiller and Air Conditioning Program
eligible_entity: Commercial complexes, IT parks, hospitals, hotels, and offices
technology: Magnetic Bearing Chillers, Inverter AC, VRF Systems with ISEER >= 5.4
eligibility: Replacement of low-efficiency or aging chillers/split units (> 7 years in operation) with ultra-high efficiency aggregated equipment.
incentive_type: Demand Aggregation Price Reduction & Upfront Rebate
incentive_value: 20% to 35% upfront price discount compared to standard market procurement rates through bulk demand aggregation.
source: EESL National Energy Efficiency Program Guidelines

name: Maharashtra Time-of-Day (ToD) Off-Peak Energy Tariff Incentive
eligible_entity: HT and LT Commercial and Industrial electricity consumers with ToD electronic metering
technology: Flexible Pump Scheduling, Chiller Pre-cooling, Load Shifting
eligibility: Shifting flexible operational equipment load to night off-peak window (22:00 to 06:00 hrs) with verified interval metering.
incentive_value: Off-peak rebate of ₹1.50 to ₹2.50 per kWh consumed during off-peak hours; avoidance of peak surcharge (₹1.50–₹3.00/kWh).
source: MERC Multi-Year Tariff Order & MSEDCL DSM Regulations

name: Gujarat DISCOM Industrial & SME Energy Efficiency Tariff Incentive
eligible_entity: SME manufacturing facilities, small industrial units, and commercial establishments
technology: Energy Efficient Motors, Industrial Pumps, Power Factor Correction, Off-Peak Scheduling
eligibility: Maintaining operating power factor > 0.95 and transferring operational equipment runtime to off-peak periods.
incentive_value: 0.5% to 1.0% overall energy bill rebate for power factor > 0.95, and night-shift concession of ₹1.25/kWh.
source: GERC Comprehensive Tariff Orders for Discoms & DSM Framework

name: Karnataka BESCOM Time-of-Day Off-Peak Tariff Concession
eligible_entity: Commercial establishments, IT/ITES facilities, and small industrial plants
technology: Chiller Scheduling, Thermal Energy Storage, Water Pumping Optimization
eligibility: Commercial or industrial consumers operating under HT-2(a), HT-2(b), or LT-5 tariffs using ToD metering to shift load.
incentive_value: Rebate of ₹1.00 to ₹1.50 per kWh for consumption between 22:00 and 06:00 hrs.
